newsitem.title: USA: Universal holders ok MEDIQ merger.
newsitem.headline: Universal holders ok MEDIQ merger.

text.p: MEDIQ Inc and Universal Hospital Services Inc said Friday that Universal shareholders had approved the company's acquisition by MEDIQ.

The company also said that the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino federal antitrust act, which was originally scheduled to expire in March, is now set to expire April 10 and could be extended by the Federal Trade Commission at any time on or before that date.
The companies agreed to combine in February in a cash merger with a total purchase price of about $138 million, including the assumption of debt.
